declaration: The RC package is an application release candidate, not a fully self-contained offline installer. It depends on host-provided Qdrant, database, environment variables, model API, and a frozen knowledge base or test KB. FastAPI and Streamlit run locally under Conda/Uvicorn; Qdrant remains Docker-only infrastructure. No production database, Qdrant data directory, frozen index, LLM cache or user-uploaded source documents are included.
